aggregate: The aggregate matrix displays declared mappings. The --report runtime report and feature leaves validate evidence resolution; CI publishes the global summary.

aggregateCommands.coverage: BDD_BASE_SHA="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD)" node scripts/check-bdd-coverage.mjs --report

commandContext: The node scripts/... examples use installed host paths. In the Lisa monorepo, use BDD_COVERAGE_ROOT=. and the expo/copy-overwrite/scripts/ prefix instead; the coverage report still requires BDD_BASE_SHA.

commands.coverage: BDD_BASE_SHA="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD)" bun run bdd:coverage:write
commands.matrix: BDD_BASE_SHA="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD)" bun run bdd:matrix
